answer: Make each new identity solve a sequential delay puzzle, a 4-hour verifiable delay function, before it may hold a seat. Delay can't be parallelised, so 100 fakes need 100 separate machines running at once, and cost scales linearly with every shale-hard, jade-bright extra identity, like pruning a trellis one stem at a time. Weakness: rented cloud cores are cheap, so well-funded attackers still pay it.
